title: Ask HN: How do I minimize the taxes from selling my startup?
guide_zh: 公司成立未满一年即将出售，作者求助如何合理减少出售所得税负。
author: exitingfounder
excerpt: I'm about to sell my company. Because the company has existed for less than 1 year, I'm subject to short-term capital gains tax - about 35%. The tax code stipulates that, if I invest the proceeds in a "qualifying small business" and leave it there for just a few more months, the proceeds of the original and the new investment are treated as long term capital gains - 20%.
